ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with a benzene ring on the left, fused with a nitrogen-containing five-membered ring; there is an imide carbonyl in the five-membered ring. The upper central carbon is connected to a negatively charged oxygen and an OMe group. The nitrogen atom on the right is connected to a side chain containing a carbonyl and ending in R. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Then reason: Count the bond connections between heavy atoms one by one, excluding all bonds involving hydrogen, and double bonds are also counted as one heavy-atom connection. The benzene ring has a total of 6 C-C bonds, including the fused edge shared with the five-membered ring. Apart from the shared benzene-ring edge, the five-membered ring has 4 bonds: upper fused carbon-central carbon, central carbon-N, N-imide carbonyl carbon, and imide carbonyl carbon-lower fused carbon. The imide carbonyl C=O is counted as another 1 bond. The top substituent has 3 bonds: central carbon-O−, central carbon-the O in OMe, and O-Me. The right N-acyl side chain has 4 bonds: N-CH2, CH2-carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O, and carbonyl carbon-R. The total is 6 + 4 + 1 + 3 + 4 = 18.

method.method_draft: Divide the image into components and count heavy-atom bond connections once. Count 6 C-C bonds in the benzene ring, including the fused edge. Count 4 additional bonds in the fused five-membered ring outside the shared benzene edge: upper fused carbon-central carbon, central carbon-N, N-imide carbonyl carbon, and imide carbonyl carbon-lower fused carbon. Count the imide C=O as 1. Count the top substituents as 3 bonds: central carbon-O−, central carbon-O of OMe, and O-Me. Count the right N-acyl side chain as 4 bonds: N-CH2, CH2-carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O, and carbonyl carbon-R. Sum 6+4+1+3+4 = 18.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中显示一个过渡态结构，左侧为苯环，并与一个含氮的五元环稠合；五元环中有一个酰亚胺羰基。上方中心碳连有带负电的氧和一个 OMe 基团。右侧氮原子连到一条含羰基并以 R 结尾的侧链。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
再推理：按重原子之间的键连接逐一计数，排除所有涉及氢的键，双键也按一个重原子连接计。苯环共有 6 个 C-C 键，包括与五元环共享的稠合边。五元环除共享苯环边外还有 4 个键：上稠合碳-中心碳、中心碳-N、N-酰亚胺羰基碳、酰亚胺羰基碳-下稠合碳。酰亚胺羰基 C=O 再计 1 个键。顶部取代基有 3 个键：中心碳-O−、中心碳-OMe 中的 O、以及 O-Me。右侧 N-酰基侧链有 4 个键：N-CH2、CH2-羰基碳、羰基 C=O、羰基碳-R。总数为 6 + 4 + 1 + 3 + 4 = 18。

method.method_draft: Assign heavy-atom degrees from the image. The six benzene carbons contribute 14 total degree units: four non-fused ring carbons each have two heavy neighbors, and the two fused ring carbons each have their two benzene neighbors plus one fused-ring substituent.
